name: xyz.task402/x402-docs
title: Task402 Agent Evidence Tools
description: Paid evidence tools for PDFs, public webpages, OpenAPI contracts, and Base chain data for AI agents.

useCases: Verify page quotes in research PDFs
Find changed pages between PDF revisions
Build a bounded cited context pack for an agent question
Fetch public webpages into citation-ready evidence
Read Base balances and transaction receipts

restOnlyOperations.download_pdf: Included with generation; bearer capability required

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.documentTools: Included after paid PDF indexing; native-text only; REST upload returns a required bearer capability.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.generationPayments: x402 v2; client must approve and sign payment separately.
limitations: Web evidence is public HTTPS HTML/text only and does not execute JavaScript
OpenAPI tools accept JSON and local references only
Chain tools never sign or submit transactions
Text matching does not verify factual truth
Comparison is page-aligned native-text comparison, not a visual or legal redline
